CORRIGENDUM for Tender Notice - 16 (2017-18) & Tender Notice - 18 (2017-18) With reference to Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram Tender Notice - 16 (2017-18) published on dated 8th December 2017 & Tender Notice -18 (2017-18) published on dated 24th December 2017 in Indian Express & Loksatta news papers, For Tender Notice - 16 (2017-18) the last date for the work mentioned may be read as 4th January, 2018 up to 3.00 pm. The Technical Bids will be opened on the next day i.e. 05/01/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. And for Tender Notice - 18 (2017-18) the Item for Microbiology
Department read as Cold Room instead of Water Bath. The Technical Bids will be opened on the next day i.e. 16/01/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The remaining terms of the tender will remain the same.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
